citations.quote: In matters related to their employment, members and candidates must not engage in conduct that harms the interests of their employer.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard IV.A REQUIRES Members and Candidates, in matters related to their employment, to act for the employer's benefit and not engage in conduct that harms the employer's interests; carve-outs permit whistleblowing on illegal/unethical conduct; post-employment client solicitation rules distinguish skills (Member's) from confidential employer property.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard IV(A) Loyalty (to Employer)
